[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]5 (Explosion Range) |speed = 2 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |flying = No }} ==Description== '''Mark II''' is the second vehicle that spawns from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawns when the [[Mecha Base]] is at Level 2. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Mark II''' has a spawnrate of 30 seconds. '''Mark II''' can attack enemies with its turret and rocket launcher. ==Appearance== '''Mark II''' is a tall light blue mechanized walker. It has long mechanized legs and its operator sits at the top of the walker. The operator can shoot rockets from its launcher and bullets from its turret. A windscreen protects the operator. The operator itself has tan skin, its torso and legs were black, and it wears white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''Mark II''' can easily wipe out hordes of enemies due to its high DPS and rocket launcher. *On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Mark II''' will spawn per Level 2 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path. *'''Mark II''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Giant Boss]]. **However, '''Mark II's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]]. *As with other [[units]], the firerate and range of '''Mark II''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''Mark II''' will struggle against some enemies with abilities that damage units. **For example, if the [[Brute]] uses its ''Smash'' attack, and a '''Mark II''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly destroyed, as the ''Stomp'' deals 1,000 damage. *The '''Mark II''' can be effective against hidden enemies, because of its high DPS and hidden detection. **The '''Mark II''' cannot detect or collide with flying enemies. Additionally, it cannot collide with ghost enemies. ==Trivia== *'''Mark II''' replaced the [[Armored XR600]], which existed before [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *'''Mark II''' was made exclusive in [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] as it is only used to test units in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]]. *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''Mark II''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Mark II''' was sent out on the path by the devs during the admin abuse part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''28 August 2020''' -
